svg.text: 'Tulip' type vertical-axis rotor – side elevation and plan
direct vertical shaft – no bevel drive
INDICATIVE ARTIST'S ILLUSTRATION – NOT TO SCALE
Dimensions to be confirmed by survey and detailed design
Commercially available 'tulip' vertical-axis rotor, but up-graded from wind duty for heavy-duty use in water.
Rotor: 1 500 mm maximum diameter x 2 200 mm high. 2 no. helically twisted shells on upper and lower hubs, set slightly off-set against one another, with 75° of twist over the height.
Vertical axis suits a straight shaft run to the pod above: no bevel drive is needed, which removes one gear box from each unit.
Blades: pressed aluminium or moulded GRP over a stainless spine. Bearings: upper thrust and lower guide, both water lubricated.
Direction-agnostic — it accepts flow from any heading without yawing, which suits a tidal site where the flow reverses.
Shown against a plain background for identification only. Sizes are indicative and to be confirmed by the supplier.
